DATASTRUCTURES/CVMappingRule.h: a hand-written struct, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, RequirementLevel and CombinationsLogic with the source MUST/OR defaults, the constructor and copy/assignment as Default/Clone, the identifier, element-path, requirement-level, combinations-logic, scope-path and CV-term get/set pairs as public fields, addCVTerm as a push on terms, ==/!= as PartialEq.
DATASTRUCTURES/CVMappingTerm.h: a hand-written struct, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, the constructor and copy/assignment as Default/Clone, the accession, use-term-name, use-term, term-name, is-repeatable, allow-children and CV-identifier-ref get/set pairs as public fields, ==/!= as PartialEq.
DATASTRUCTURES/CVMappings.h: a hand-written struct, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, the constructor and copy/assignment as Default/Clone, set/getMappingRules and addMappingRule on the public mapping_rules field, setCVReferences/getCVReferences/addCVReference/hasCVReference as set_cv_references/cv_references/add_cv_reference/has_cv_reference over a private presence index, ==/!= as PartialEq.
DATASTRUCTURES/CVReference.h: a hand-written struct, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, the constructor and copy/assignment as Default/Clone, the name and identifier get/set pairs as public fields, ==/!= as PartialEq.
DATASTRUCTURES/DIntervalBase.h: a hand-written const-generic port, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, DIMENSION, the constructors (default, copy/move, corner pair), min/maxPosition, setMin/setMax/setMinMax, assign across dimensions, ==/!= as PartialEq, + += - -= by a position as Add/AddAssign/Sub/SubAssign, clear, both isEmpty overloads (is_empty/is_empty_dim), setDimMinMax, center, diagonal, the empty and zero statics as const fns, min/maxX/Y with their setters, width, height, operator<< as Display.
DATASTRUCTURES/DPosition.h: a hand-written const-generic port, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, DIMENSION, the constructors (default, fill, x/y, x/y/z) as new/filled/xy/xyz, copy/move as Copy, swap as std::mem::swap, abs, both operator[] as Index/IndexMut (plus checked get/get_mut), getX/getY/setX/setY, the six comparisons and spatiallyLessEqual/GreaterEqual, + += - -= unary - as the ops traits, the inner product operator* as Mul/dot, *= /= and the free scalar * / as MulAssign/DivAssign/Mul/Div, clear, zero/minPositive/minNegative/maxPositive, begin/end as iter/iter_mut/IntoIterator, operator<< as Display. The TCoordinateType parameter is fixed to f64: DPosition.cpp's two Int anchors and HashGrid's DPosition<2, Int64> CellIndex (HashGrid is unported) have no counterpart.
DATASTRUCTURES/DRange.h: a hand-written const-generic port over DIntervalBase, not a standard-library type: every public member is covered, DIMENSION, DRangeIntersection, the constructors (default, corners, copy/move, from Base, the 2D four-coordinate xy), both assignments and both operator== as Clone/From/PartialEq, both encloses overloads (encloses/encloses_xy), united, intersects, isIntersected, both extend overloads as extend_by_factor/extend_by, ensureMinSpan, swapDimensions, pullIn (returns the point), operator<< as Display.
DATASTRUCTURES/DateTime.h: a hand-written port (parser, formatter, Gregorian arithmetic) whose local and UTC clocks come from the chrono crate, so neither the standard library alone nor no-port-owed applies: every public member is covered, the constructor and copy/move as Default/Copy, ==/!= as PartialEq, operator< as source_less, both setDate and both setTime overloads (string and components), set/get of all six components, both getDate and both getTime overloads (components and string), addSecs as add_seconds, now, nowUTC, isValid, isNull, clear, toString(format) as format, fromString as from_format, get()/set(string), and the std::hash specialisation as Hash.
DATASTRUCTURES/ExposedVector.h: stays: every public member is a delegating std::vector call, and Vec<T>, slices, iterators, the comparison traits and std::mem discharge each one with no crate.
DATASTRUCTURES/TypeAliases.h: stays: the header is three typedefs, and Vec<i32>, Vec<f64> and Vec<String> are standard-library types.
DATASTRUCTURES/Utils/MapUtilities.h: stays (the 2026-09-21 decision): the four public members are traversal templates over a CRTP base with no state, and standard iterator combinators over the features and unassigned_peptide_identifications fields discharge them with no crate.
